merge_push_body: Notes brought in from the other copy: {added}. Notes that differed: {conflicts}. The list is under “Memory merge report” on the assistant's Memory page.
merge_report_description: What was brought into this memory from the copies other conversations kept, and which notes differed
merge_report_intro: Until now, some conversations kept a memory of their own that this page did not show. All conversations now share this one. The notes below came from the other copy. Where both had a note with the same file name and different content, the one modified later was kept. Nothing was deleted: the other copy is still where it was, and each merge saved a backup first. To change a result, edit the note on this page, or ask Persona to use the other version. You can delete this report when you are done with it.
merge_report_backup: Backup of this memory as it was, and of the notes that were read: {path}
merge_report_kept_copy: Kept: the other copy's version, modified {copy_time}. It replaced this memory's version, modified {memory_time}.
merge_report_kept_memory: Kept: this memory's version, modified {memory_time}. The other copy's version, modified {copy_time}, was not used.
merge_report_other: The version that was not kept:
merge_report_truncated: The text above is cut short; the whole file is in the backup.
